You spent $3,420 last month and got 87 bookings at $39 each. That's a 3.8x ROAS. But $640/mo is going to waste.

The biggest problem

$412/mo is going to junk placements — 34 low-quality sites generated 2,100 impressions with zero conversions.

Your ads run 24/7 but not a single booking after 9pm in 60 days. That's $148/mo wasted.

What I'd do
1

Exclude 34 junk placements

Saves $412/mo. Sites like weatherwidget.io and 32 others.

2

Pause ads 9pm–7am

Saves $148/mo. 94% of conversions happen 8am–8pm.

3

Add 38 negative keywords

Saves $80/mo. Searches like "med spa jobs" and "diy facial".

4

Fix conversion tracking

Book Now button fires twice — inflating bookings by ~15%.

Bottom line

4 fixes save $640/mo — est. 15\u201320 more bookings. ROAS from 3.8x to 4.4x.

Frequently asked questions

Ryze provides autonomous AI agents for three core areas: paid ads optimization (Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn), SEO automation (technical audits, content optimization, rank tracking), and an AI website builder that generates high-converting landing pages.

Ryze connects to your ad platforms via API. AI agents continuously audit performance, identify wasted spend, optimize bids and budgets, generate creatives, and can apply changes with one click — all 24/7.

The SEO agent runs continuous technical audits, fixes broken links, optimizes title tags and meta descriptions, adds schema markup, monitors Core Web Vitals, and tracks your rankings — all automatically.

Yes. The website builder generates pages from your brand guidelines, A/B tests layouts automatically, and optimizes for conversions. Pages are built to work seamlessly with your ad campaigns and SEO strategy.

Absolutely. Ryze is built for agencies. Manage hundreds of client accounts from one dashboard, with AI agents running ads, SEO, and website optimizations across all of them simultaneously.

For ads: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn. For SEO: Google Search Console, Analytics, Perplexity, ChatGPT search. For websites: Shopify, custom domains, and more. Plus Slack/Teams for reporting.

Most users see actionable insights within minutes of connecting their accounts. AI agents identify optimization opportunities across ads, SEO, and your website immediately.
